d: US President Donald Trump has become an unexpected internet sensation after arriving in Manila, Philippines, with a noticeably darker and fuller hairstyle. Social media users were quick to compare his new look with his usual golden-blond hair, sparking jokes, memes and speculation about whether he had dyed it during his flight to Asia. As Trump arrived for the 49th ASEAN Summit, his hair became an unlikely talking point, with the internet buzzing over his dramatic makeover.
